claim_en: THE NIGHT WINDOW AND THE ONE-WAY ALTAR: The limbs are placed at sunset and burn all night; day-pieces (the fistful, incense, frankincense, wood, the priests' and libation meal-offerings) ride up at night through the comprehensive 'law of the olah'; 'until the morning' is freed to the ash removal — its window is the whole night. And the altar is ONE-WAY: what is fit, once up, does not come down — R. Yehoshua classing by fire-fitness, R. Gamliel by altar-fitness (their recorded delta: unfit blood and libations), R. Shimon's principle sealing it: the courtyard accepts what became unfit INSIDE it (overnight, gone-out, tamei, wrong time or place, unfit handlers stay up; night-slaughter, spille...

THE CONSECRATING SURFACES: The altar consecrates what is appropriate to it (Exod 29:37); the RAMP is included; the ministering vessels consecrate what is appropriate to them (Exod 30:29) — and the vessels are TYPED: wet consecrates wet, dry measures dry, never across; a punctured vessel consecrates only while it still performs its whole-function; all of it inside the courtyard only.

ONE FIRE SOURCE: The inner incense altar's fire is kindled from the outer altar ('the fire of the altar shall be kindled thereby'); the menorah's rides the continuous-fire clause with Exod 27:20; the Yom Kippur coal pan's is sealed by Lev 16:12 — 'from off the altar BEFORE the LORD': the altar which is partly, not wholly, before the LORD is the outer one. The whole fire topology drains from one source.

THE ASH-LIFTING PROTOCOL: The linen garment is cut to his SIZE; the linen spec runs byssus, new, six-stranded, worn with no other garments (Rebbi: even worn ones valid — the recorded three-way on what 'shall put on' adds); breeches directly on the flesh, nothing interposing, nothing before them. The ashes lifted are the innermost consumed coals — not wood-ash, not limbs — placed gently, all, unscattered, beside the altar; unconsumed limbs return to the altar's sides; a limb that sprang off before midnight is returned and still carries sacrilege liability — the fire's claim runs to midnight.

THE CARRYING GARMENTS: 'Other garments' for taking the ashes out are likened to the ones taken off — CONSECRATED, but lesser in value; R. Elazar reads 'others': blemished priests, unfit for the services, are kasher for the ash-carrying — it is not a priestly service proper.

THE PERPETUAL FIRE MACHINE: Extinguishing the altar fire is a NEGATIVE COMMANDMENT; kindling happens on top of the altar; a sustenance pile feeds the flame. The morning runs on a PRECEDENCE ALGORITHM read off the doubled 'in the morning': the two logs precede the daily offering, the wood precedes the incense, the lamps precede the incense; the great pile carries every offering. THE DAY BRACKET: nothing precedes the morning tamid, nothing follows the afternoon tamid — 'the completers.' 'Continuous' overrides the Sabbath and tumah; on the journeys the fire is kept — R. Yehudah inverting a vessel over it, R. Shimon carrying it on a pan (dual-track); and the wood-pile COUNT is a recorded nume...

THE MEAL-OFFERING INTAKE: ONE LAW for all meal-offerings: oil and frankincense even for the wholly-burnt (the priests' own); Temple as tabernacle; no bamah. Presentation: fit only, all at once, the sons not the daughters; and the CORNER ALGORITHM — 'before the LORD' intersected with 'in front of the altar' resolves to the SOUTHWEST corner, R. Eliezer naming the resolution rule: prefer the reading that satisfies both verses. The fistful: one tenth-measure in ONE vessel, no vessel for the fist, no neighbor's flour or oil, the frankincense present in the vessel at the taking, then picked out and smoked.

THE REMAINDER LAWS: Only a VALID offering's remainder is eaten; the multiplied eating-verbs permit any manner and allow mundane food and terumah alongside it WHEN INSUFFICIENT (never when ample); eating it unleavened is a MITZVAH — the permitted-forbidden-permitted ladder does not restore the original permission without the written command; even a surviving part is eaten; the place is the courtyard, including chambers on mundane ground that open into the holy.

LEAVEN AND APPORTIONMENT: 'Shall not be BAKED leavened' singles baking out to teach PER-OPERATION liability — kneading and rolling each liable in themselves. Apportionment waits for the fire: the priests divide only after the fistful is consigned (all offerings, through 'holy of holies'); the unfit is not divided; premature division does not unfit. The double comparison: like the sin-offering — from mundane money, by day, with the right hand; like the guilt-offering — a fistful taken not-for-its-sake stays FIT; R. Shimon partitions instead: the sinner's offering follows the sin-offering rule, the gift the guilt-offering rule (dual-track).

TOUCH AND SHARE: 'Every male' includes the blemished FOR APPORTIONMENT; the statute spans the Temple and the generations; eating follows the fire-offering. Touch-sanctification requires ABSORPTION ('in them'); partial contact taints the touched part only — it is cut away; what touches becomes LIKE the offering: unfit if unfit, eaten under its stringencies if fit.

source: Onkelos Leviticus 6:13; Sifra, Tzav, Chapter 5; Sifra, Tzav, Section 3
claim_en: THE PERPETUAL GRIDDLE OFFERING: The tenth-measure GATES SERVICE: a high priest or ordinary priest who served before bringing his investiture tenth — service INVALID. Anointing by day; never two high priests at once. THE HALVING INVARIANT: 'its half' means half of a WHOLE tenth — bring whole, divide, half at morning half at evening; a tamei evening half, or a successor priest mid-day, brings a NEW WHOLE and halves it (two halves offered, two lost — the recorded ledger). The measure is the data channel's own arithmetic: one-tenth of three se'im — seven quarters and a fraction — with Onkelos performing the conversion inside the verse ('one of ten in three se'im'). Succession: the son precede...

THE GRIDDLE SPEC: The griddle is a ministering vessel; the oil quantity is DERIVED BY RESEMBLANCE: three logs per tenth-measure from the libation meal-offering — the recorded selection rule preferring the daily offering that overrides Sabbath and tumah (two more recorded routes to the same three logs; the two-log ram-route refuted by all-one-tenth likeness). 'Soaked' means scalded with hot oil to saturation — a THREE-SEAT CENSUS: no other soaked offering in the Torah but this, the thanksgiving bread, and the investiture bread. Brought before the libations; the baking verb carries a recorded three-way (lightly / beautifully / many); folding: the high priest's to two, the ordinary priest's ...

THE PRIEST'S OWN MEAL-OFFERING: Never eaten — but the priest's DAUGHTER's is eaten (the class boundary runs on the priest, not the priestly line); his gift offering included; even part liable; the doubled 'entire' (kalil) cross-applies whole-smoking and the eating ban between 6:15 and 6:16; R. Eliezer: everything under 'entire' adds a negative commandment for eating.

THE SIN-OFFERING'S LAW: ONE LAW for all sin-offerings: the blood-on-garment WASHING reaches even the inner burnt ones (the a-fortiori that would exempt them defeated); the BIRD offering excluded — its pinching is not slaughter; every sin-offering slaughtered NORTH (with R. Eliezer's fixed-olah derivation and the communal peace-offerings included); the eater is the offering-priest class, excluding the day-immersed, the atonement-lacking, and the mourner; and the blood belongs ABOVE — applied below it does not atone: the 'it' exclusion holds against the one-application leniency and the inner-blood counter.

THE WASHING MACHINE: Washing rides FIT blood — with the recorded three-way on blood unfitted later (R. Akiva's time-of-fitness criterion against R. Shimon's never); only ITS blood (not neighbors', not broth); only the SPOT; and the SPRINKLE-FITNESS criterion sorts the case table: from the hand before sprinkling — wash; after — no; spilled from the vessel and gathered — wash; from the neck or off the horn and base — no. Garment scope is a recorded dispute (tumah-capable vs implement). Washing happens IN THE HOLY PLACE, and the juxtaposition extends the venue to the breaking and scouring; the ruled RETURN TABLE: garment out — returned and washed inside; tamei outside — torn, returned, washe...

THE VESSEL PURGE: Earthenware (alum-crystal vessels included) BREAKS — cooked in or hot-poured alike; copper stands for ALL METALS and SCOURS AND RINSES — repeated cookings, one purge at the end (R. Tarfon's festival window against the sages' eating-time, dual-track); scour within, rinse without; the rinse water: any amount, water only, any water. The purge rides offerings with a FIT phase (R. Yaakov against R. Shimon — the same criterion pair as the washing); 'every male' closes the blemish ladder at PERMANENT blemishes; and the TASTE THRESHOLD: mixtures where the stringent imparts taste are eaten under its stringencies — below it, no touch-unfitness and no purge.

THE ENTRY BOUNDARY: A sin-offering whose blood — even PART of it — enters the tent is not eaten but burned; the two-cups table (one out: the inner kasher; one in: R. Yossi Haglili keeps the outer fit against the sages, dual-track); the boundary is DIRECTIONAL — what enters unfits, what leaves does not ('into the tent of meeting'); it holds at Shiloh and the Temple; whether ENTRY alone unfits or only atonement made inside is the recorded R. Eliezer / R. Shimon dispute (unwitting entry kasher on the second view). Burning is in the holy place, extended to all invalidated higher-order offerings; and the tamei-flesh BURN-LOCATION matrix is carried in four recorded resolutions — Beth Shammai an...
